# uzc_vm_autoscale_condition (Resource)

Manages a scale-down condition on a UzCloud VM Autoscale group (POST/PUT/DELETE /autoscale/{autoscale}/conditions, the spec's own JSON key for these is "scale_down_policies"). The resource ID is "{autoscale}/{condition_id}".

TODO(api): same caveats as uzc_vm_autoscale_policy: no GET/list for a single condition, and the create response's id needs verification against a live account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# TODO(api): the spec exposes no GET/list for a single condition, so this
# resource cannot be imported and its Read cannot detect drift.
resource "uzc_vm_autoscale_condition" "example" {
  autoscale  = uzc_vm_autoscale.example.slug
  name       = "scale-down-on-memory"
  duration   = 60
  quiet_time = 60

  conditions = [
    {
      counter       = "29b53220-8d64-11ef-8ce4-000c298fabeb"
      counter_id    = "29b53220-8d64-11ef-8ce4-000c298fabeb"
      operator      = "LT"
      threshold     = 20
      counter_label = "VM Memory - average percentage"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `autoscale` (String) Slug of the uzc_vm_autoscale group to attach the condition to.
- `conditions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `duration` (Number) Seconds.
- `name` (String)
- `quiet_time` (Number) Seconds.

### Optional

- `updated_policy_duration` (Number)
- `updated_policy_name` (String)
- `updated_policy_quiet_time` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `condition_id` (String) Server-assigned condition id.
- `id` (String) "{autoscale}/{condition_id}". Used for import.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Required:

- `counter` (String) Counter UUID.
- `counter_id` (String)
- `operator` (String) e.g. "GT", "LT".
- `threshold` (Number)

Optional:

- `counter_label` (String) e.g. "VM CPU - average percentage".
